name: Heavy Palm
description: Drive the open palm into the target's chest with the whole body's weight and a pulse of qi behind it.
first_area: Chapter 006 — The Edge of the Forest (Ref: 1.1.1.006)

name: Brace Stance
description: Plant both feet and lock the frame so qi in the legs holds the user against a hard shove.

name: Mass Footfall
description: Shift the body's mass onto the lead foot in one stride that closes distance without losing balance.

name: Sinew Surge
description: Flood the user's arms and back with qi so the muscles pull harder for a short while.

name: Clamp Seizure
description: Seize a wrist or forearm and clench until the target cannot pull free.

name: Heft Read
description: Feel the weight and stance of a body in contact to judge how hard it can push back.

name: Lift Press
description: Drive both palms upward under the target's guard and heave so the blow lifts the opponent off balance.

name: Hoist Clasp
description: Wrap both arms about the target's torso and hoist so its arms are pinned against its sides.

name: Raised Brace
description: Lift both forearms across the head and pour qi into the bones to hold up a falling blow.

name: Haul Stride
description: Take a long driving stride under load with legs strong enough to carry weight and still move.

name: Shoulder Charge
description: Lower the shoulder and drive forward so the full mass of the body lands in one shove.

name: Arm Swell
description: Draw qi into both arms until the muscle swells and every lift or pull comes with more force.

name: Load Sense
description: Test an object or body with one lift to learn its true weight before committing to move it.

name: Hammer Fist
description: Close the hand and bring the base of the fist down like a mallet onto the target's guard.

name: Knuckle Jab
description: Drive two leading knuckles into a soft point with qi gathered at the tips.

name: Fist Parry
description: Knock an incoming strike aside with the back of the fist before it lands.

name: Pound Rhythm
description: Keep a steady beat of hand strikes while qi builds in the arms so each blow lands harder.

name: Wrist Snap
description: Slap a striking wrist with a short snap that throws the attacker's aim off its line.

name: Might Burst
description: Release a short burst of qi through the whole body into one straight blow of raw force.

name: Brawn Guard
description: Tense the torso and fill the muscles with qi so blows land on a body hardened to take them.

name: Rooted Rise
description: Push off a planted foot to rise or lunge in one heavy and balanced movement.

name: Heavy Shove
description: Push the target back with both hands so the opponent loses ground and cannot press forward.
first_area: Chapter 006 — The Edge of the Forest (Ref: 1.1.1.006)

name: Thew Pulse
description: Send a quick pulse of qi through the user's muscles for a single stronger movement.

name: Pin Press
description: Lean the body's weight onto a downed or cornered target to hold it still.

name: Strain Reckoning
description: Read the strain in the user's own limbs to judge how much more force the body can give.

name: Burden Carry
description: Spread qi along the spine and legs so a heavy load or a wounded ally can be carried at speed.

name: Shoulder Haul
description: Shift qi into the shoulders and back so a heavy load rides high and steady.

name: Bear Clasp
description: Close both arms about the target's chest and squeeze until its breath and strength fail.

name: Carry Swing
description: Swing a heavy load or the full body behind the arm in one sweeping blow.

name: Load Brace
description: Set the legs wide and brace the carried weight against the chest to take a blow without falling.

name: Steady Stride
description: Walk and turn under load with qi in the thighs so the pace never falters.

name: Mass Gauge
description: Judge the weight and balance of a load or a body by the feel of the first lift.

name: Straight Fist
description: Throw the closed fist in a straight line from the hip with shoulder and hip turning together.

name: Hook Fist
description: Swing the fist in a short arc to the side of the head or the ribs with the weight following.

name: Fist Guard
description: Close both fists before the face and chest and fill the forearms with qi to take a blow.

name: Recoil Lunge
description: Step back from a blow and spring forward along the same line to return it at once.

name: Knuckle Surge
description: Pack qi into the knuckles and wrists so every punch lands with firmer bone behind it.

name: Clench Break
description: Crush down on an opposing hand or wrist with a clenched fist to break its hold.

name: Impact Sense
description: Read how hard a landed blow struck and where the body took it by the feel in the fist.

name: Vise Grip
description: Close a hand on the target's limb and tighten with qi until the grip cannot be shaken.

name: Wrench Pull
description: Wrench a held arm or collar sharply to drag the target off its feet.

name: Hold Brace
description: Lock the elbows and knees while gripping so a struggling target cannot break the user's stance.

name: Grapple Step
description: Shuffle in close under the target's reach while keeping both hands free to seize.

name: Grip Surge
description: Push qi into the fingers and forearms so a hold lasts longer and tightens harder.

name: Hip Throw
description: Turn the hip under a held target and heave so the body flies over and lands hard.

name: Palm Thrust
description: Shoot the open palm straight out from the shoulder with qi gathered at the heel of the hand.

name: Palm Parry
description: Slap an incoming blow aside with the flat of the palm before it reaches the body.

name: Palm Press
description: Hold the palm against the target's chest or arm and press so it cannot raise a strike.

name: Palm Weight
description: Gather qi into both palms so that every push and strike carries more weight.

name: Slide Step
description: Slide the rear foot up behind the lead foot so the next palm lands from a fresh angle.

name: Heave Throw
description: Heave a seized body or a heavy object at the target using the full weight of the legs.

name: Drag Haul
description: Seize a limb and haul the target along the ground so it cannot find its feet.

name: Heavy Hoist
description: Fill the arms and legs with qi so a very heavy thing can be raised and held aloft.

name: Heave Guard
description: Hold a heavy object or a seized body before the user as a shield against incoming blows.

name: Haul Rush
description: Rush forward while dragging a weight so the pull itself adds speed to the charge.

name: Tug Break
description: Tug hard on a limb or a weapon arm to break the target's footing and its aim.

name: Bulk Surge
description: Throw a heavy pulse of qi through the back and legs for one great lift or pull.

name: Load Test
description: Strain gently against a weight to learn whether the arms can raise it before the full lift.

name: Stance Hold
description: Sink low with feet planted and let qi in the legs absorb a shove or a heavy blow.

name: Plant Stride
description: Set each foot down with weight and push off it so every stride is firm and balanced.

name: Rooted Strike
description: Drive a fist or palm up from the planted back foot so the legs power the blow.

name: Brace Counter
description: Take a blow on the braced forearm and turn it aside while the other hand strikes back.

name: Leg Surge
description: Flow qi down into the thighs and calves so every push from the ground gains power.

name: Stance Read
description: Read where a target's weight sits from its stance and know which way it can be moved.
